Whether an aliased specifier names a design directory has no separate currently observable activation fact.

review.summary: All hard-case and sampled segments retain their knowledge, and the shared phase-loop guidance does not displace the rule-specific requirements. I agree with the auditor's PASS; residual concerns are the terse alias-classification wording and the explicitly declared need for an import-resolution observer.
